shots.action: hop out of the sand tombs in formation
shots.soundMood: rhythmic hopping thuds, dry cloth rustle
shots.lockedLookBlock: Wuxia desert epic in painterly live-action style, ochre sand and blood-red dusk against cold moonlit blue night, tattered grey-brown beggar robes against ornate dark Qing robes, dust and sand in the air, dynamic wuxia wire-fu camera with sweeping crane and tracking moves, high contrast, no modern objects, no saturated neon.

lockedCharacterBlocks.Jiangshi: hopping vampires in rotting dark Qing robes with faded gold trim, paper talismans on their foreheads, arms held stiffly forward, green-grey skin, moving in stiff, hopping formation

shots.background: Foreground: tomb steps half-buried in sand. Midground: three tomb doors with carved lintels, the centre door open and dark. Deep background: dune face at night, moonlit, no vegetation.
shots.choreography: Beat 1 (0-3s): Darkness in the centre tomb door, dust falling. Beat 2 (3-7s): Jiangshi hop out in formation, in unison, one hop per second. Beat 3, payoff (7-10s): The line of vampires holds formation facing the caravanserai lights, hold on the formation.
shots.cameraChoreography: Locked-off: camera does not move, so the hopping formation reads clearly against the dune face, wide framing with all tomb doors visible.
shots.lighting: Cold moonlight from above, lantern light from the caravanserai far behind the camera, tomb interiors pitch dark.
shots.focus: Deep focus: tomb doors, vampires, and dune face all sharp.
shots.motion: Subject motion: stiff hopping in unison, arms forward. Background motion: dust falling from the tomb door, nothing else. Camera still, subjects move — the horror is in the contrast.
shots.extras: No beggar extras; the vampires are the only figures, in a line of five.
shots.loreNotes: Jiangshi rules 1, 2, 3, 5: hop only, blind, no speech, no tiring, arms stiffly forward. Rule 4: eyes closed or downcast while sealed.

departments.production-design: Lintel motif: sun disc with a line through it, same on both tomb doors
departments.makeup-sfx: Eyes closed or downcast in s04; skin green-grey, cracked at knuckles
departments.sound: Rhythmic hopping thuds in unison, dry cloth rustle, no music

shots.action: strikes the first vampire with his staff
shots.lockedLookBlock: Wuxia desert epic in painterly live-action style, ochre sand and blood-red dusk against cold moonlit blue night, tattered grey-brown beggar robes against ornate dark Qing robes, dust and sand in the air, dynamic wuxia wire-fu camera with sweeping crane and tracking moves, high contrast, no modern objects, no saturated neon.

lockedCharacterBlocks.Chief Hong: a weathered one-eyed beggar chief in his 60s with a grey beard, patched grey-brown robes, a rope belt, and a knotted wooden staff, moving with slow, deliberate authority
lockedCharacterBlocks.Jiangshi: hopping vampires in rotting dark Qing robes with faded gold trim, paper talismans on their foreheads, arms held stiffly forward, green-grey skin, moving in stiff, hopping formation

shots.background: Foreground: courtyard dust kicked up by hopping. Midground: Hong facing the first vampire in the courtyard centre. Deep background: lantern line with five lanterns, three lit, torn awning moving.
shots.choreography: Beat 1 (0-3s): Vampire hops forward toward Hong, arms stiff, Hong plants his feet, staff grounded. Beat 2 (3-7s): Hong swings the staff in a low arc, striking the vampire's stiff arms, vampire staggers back one hop, talisman corner lifting. Beat 3, payoff (7-10s): Hong holds the staff across his body, breathing hard, vampire reeling but not fallen, hold on Hong's face.
shots.cameraChoreography: Tracking: camera tracks Hong from his right side, keeping both fighters in frame, ending on Hong's held pose.
shots.lighting: Cold moonlight with warm lantern light from the left, staff and faces lit, courtyard shadows deep.
shots.focus: Focus on Hong and the vampire, lanterns soft behind.
shots.motion: Subject motion: hop, swing, stagger, hold. Background motion: dust and awning cloth. Camera tracks the swing, then stops on the hold.
shots.extras: Two beggar extras at the courtyard edge, frozen, watching — they do not join this fight yet.
shots.loreNotes: Jiangshi rules 1, 5, 7: hop only, arms stiff, stopped not killed by staff blows. The vampire must not fall or be destroyed here, or the threat collapses.

departments.choreography: Dog-Beating Staff style: low arcs, trips, blocks, never high flourishes
departments.makeup-sfx: Talisman corner lifts in beat 2, no other talisman moves
departments.sound: Staff crack sharp and woody, one low drum hit on the strike, then nothing

shots.action: flutters loose from a vampire's forehead
shots.emotionalBeat: the scare deepens, the seal is broken
shots.lockedLookBlock: Wuxia desert epic in painterly live-action style, ochre sand and blood-red dusk against cold moonlit blue night, tattered grey-brown beggar robes against ornate dark Qing robes, dust and sand in the air, dynamic wuxia wire-fu camera with sweeping crane and tracking moves, high contrast, no modern objects, no saturated neon.

lockedCharacterBlocks.Jiangshi: hopping vampires in rotting dark Qing robes with faded gold trim, paper talismans on their foreheads, arms held stiffly forward, green-grey skin, moving in stiff, hopping formation

shots.background: Foreground: the vampire's shoulder and rotting robe edge, out of focus at the frame edge. Midground: the vampire's forehead and talisman, centred. Deep background: courtyard dark, one lantern glow blurred.
shots.choreography: Beat 1 (0-3s): Close on the talisman, one corner lifting in wind. Beat 2 (3-7s): The talisman flutters loose and falls away from the forehead. Beat 3, payoff (7-10s): The vampire's eyes open fully and black, hold on the eyes in silence.
shots.cameraChoreography: Locked-off: camera does not move, so the talisman flutter and the eye opening read as the only movement in frame.
shots.lighting: Single lantern light on the vampire's face, rest of the frame dark, eyes catching the light as they open.
shots.focus: Shallow focus: talisman and eyes sharp, shoulder and background blurred.
shots.motion: Subject motion: almost none except the talisman flutter and the eyes opening. Background motion: none. Camera still — stillness is the scare.
shots.extras: No extras in frame; this is a two-figure moment isolated to one face.
shots.loreNotes: Jiangshi rule 4, the trailer's mechanism: talisman seals the vampire, eyes closed while sealed; when it loosens, eyes open fully and the vampire becomes faster and more dangerous. This happens to exactly one vampire, the lead, only here.

departments.makeup-sfx: Eyes black and fully open only from beat 3 onward, never earlier
departments.costume: Talisman yellow paper, black seal script, centre-forehead, missing from this vampire from s06 onward
departments.sound: Paper flutter close and dry, then three seconds of sudden silence
